<div class="events-carousel">
            <div class="events-container" id="eventsContainer">
                <div class="events-slide active">
                    <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Philly Tech Week Hackathon 2024">
                    <div class="slide-caption">
                        <h3>Philly Tech Week Innovation Hackathon</h3>
                        <p>48 hours of innovation and creativity</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="events-slide">
                    <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Weekly Coding Session">
                    <div class="slide-caption">
                        <h3>Weekly Coding Sessions</h3>
                        <p>Collaborative coding and learning</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="carousel-slide active">
                    <div class="slide-background" style="background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,')"></div>
                    <div class="slide-content">
                        <h2>React Workshop</h2>
                        <p>Building modern web applications with React - a hands-on workshop for developers of all skill levels.</p>
                        <a href="/blog" class="btn-primary">Read More</a>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="events-slide">
                    <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Tech Networking Night">
                    <div class="slide-caption">
                        <h3>Tech Networking Night</h3>
                        <p>Connecting Philly's tech community</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="events-slide">
                    <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64, " alt="Python Bootcamp">
                    <div class="slide-caption">
                        <h3>Python Bootcamp</h3>
                        <p>From basics to advanced concepts</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            
            <button class="carousel-btn carousel-prev" onclick="changeSlide(-1)">❮</button>
            <button class="carousel-btn carousel-next" onclick="changeSlide(1)">❯</button>
            
            
            <div class="carousel-indicators">
                <button class="indicator active" onclick="currentSlide(1)"></button>
                <button class="indicator" onclick="currentSlide(2)"></button>
                <button class="indicator" onclick="currentSlide(3)"></button>
                <button class="indicator" onclick="currentSlide(4)"></button>
                <button class="indicator" onclick="currentSlide(5)"></button>
            </div>
        </div>
